## [[Word {{< iconify selfhst:microsoft-word-2013 >}}]{.msword .Bigger}](https://quarto.org/docs/output-formats/ms-word.html)

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}
### Pros {{< iconify openmoji:check-mark >}}  

+ Ubiquity {{< iconify noto:face-with-monocle >}}
+ Columns, bullets, notes, code echoing
+ Portability across rendering formats
+ End--user customization\*

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
### Cons {{< iconify streamline-ultimate-color:delete-2 >}}

+ Style (strongest control with [templates](https://quarto.org/docs/presentations/powerpoint.html#powerpoint-templates))
+ Sharability options
+ No interactivity support
+ End--user customization\*

:::
